notes.title: Feb. 7 [Patch Notes]
notes.content:
Hello everyone, regarding the card adjustments made yesterday, some of the intended changes were accidentally omitted. Therefore, we have implemented additional adjustments today.

1. The adjustments to the cards are not meant to restrict the use of certain strategies or to encourage players to adopt a fixed strategy. Instead, they aim to:
   - Ensure that all strategies have value, rather than making one strategy the only viable option.
   - Prevent any single card from being overwhelmingly powerful and mindlessly included in any deck.
   - Reduce the repetition of the same action during a single persuasion attempt.

2. For the currently popular card-drawing strategy, there are two main adjustments (one was implemented in yesterday's update, and the other was omitted and has been added today):
   - Weakened [Positive Thinking], reducing its individual card value while keeping the number of cards drawn unchanged, ensuring it doesn't affect the initiation and potential of the card-drawing strategy.
   - Enhanced [Pie in the Sky], significantly improving the initiation speed and potential of the card-drawing strategy.

3. For non-card-drawing strategies that use [Positive Thinking] solely as a means to draw cards:
   - Due to the correction of the [Drunkenness] buff (its effect has been doubled), it actually yields higher benefits than before the adjustment. Additionally, we have collected a lot of feedback from players regarding issues such as high repetition in mid-to-late game card play. In a major update within February, the skill of the helper [Auntie Wang] will be revamped. After unlocking [Auntie Wang], the maximum membership fee obtained from inviting ordinary members will be recorded. Subsequently, when encountering ordinary members with the same condition card, the persuasion process can be skipped, and the recorded maximum membership fee can be obtained directly.
     - Example: If you previously encountered an ordinary member with the [Stingy] condition and obtained 30,000 in membership fees, the next time you encounter an ordinary member with the same [Stingy] condition, you can "choose" to invite them directly and receive 30,000 in membership fees (the final value will account for current bonuses). Alternatively, you can "choose" to challenge again to refresh the previously recorded maximum fee.

4. **Card Adjustments:**
   - [Pie in the Sky]
     After adjustment: Increases membership fees by 60, then increases by 30 for each card drawn.
     Before adjustment: Increases membership fees by 60, then increases by 20 for each card drawn.
   - [Improvise]
     Patience cost adjusted to 1 (previously 0).
     After adjustment: Choose to add 1 Communication or Bargaining card to your hand and reduce its patience cost to 0.
     Before adjustment: Choose to add 1 Communication or Bargaining card to your hand.
   - [Strategic Planning]
     After adjustment: When successfully replacing a card, draw 1 card for each successful replacement (deactivates after 5 triggers).
     Before adjustment: When successfully replacing a card, draw 1 card (deactivates after 5 triggers).

5. **Persuasion State Adjustments:**
   The maximum stackable buff effect layers have been adjusted to 99 (previously 50).

6. **Skill Effect Adjustments:**
   - The skill effect of [Discover Treasure] at level 1 has been adjusted to increase Luck by 15 (previously 7).
   - The skill effect of [Discover Treasure] at level 2 has been adjusted to increase Luck by 35 (previously 21).

7. **Fixes:**
   - Fixed an issue where different system languages and time zones could cause the game to freeze.
   - Fixed discrepancies between skill effect descriptions and actual effects.
   - Fixed an issue where Nicole's storyline quest might not unlock CG correctly under certain circumstances (after the fix, even if the quest was already completed, reloading the save will directly unlock the corresponding CG).

Thank you for your understanding and support! We will continue to work hard to bring you a better gaming experience.

**[Game Development Team]**

notes.title: Update notice | Added new great BUFF
notes.content:
Hello everyone! This is the production team of "Chinese-style Blind Date".

First of all, we apologize for the lagging and crashing issues caused by yesterday's small update! At present, the issue has been fixed in the 1.0.81 version at noon on the 27th. In the future, we will pay more attention to testing and optimization, and continue to listen to everyone's voice and optimize the game experience in time according to your feedback.

At the same time, we have optimized the game's economic system and added membership fee bonuses, hoping to make everyone's earning experience easier and more enjoyable. Welcome everyone to join the game experience!

New features include:
1. When the club level is raised, the final membership fee value obtained by inviting members will also increase. For each level raised, the membership fee bonus will increase by 20%.
2. New card recommendation function, you can view the recommended deck and support one-click export of existing cards in the application
3. Join the clubhouse-apprenticeship function interface at the same time, and now you can check the rewards for completing the apprenticeship series tasks in advance.

Thank you for your continuous encouragement and understanding. If you have any suggestions or encounter other problems, you can always let us know by email. We will listen carefully and try our best to improve.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/31572ecc56ebd075b70df1225922750ea47e4848.png[/img]

notes.title: Roadmap for Matchmaking Inc. in 2025
notes.content:
Hello everyone!  

This is an announcement from development team Wave Games, along with our publisher, Lightning Games. Thank you to every player for your support, feedback, and enthusiasm since the game’s release. Whether it’s sharp comments, in-depth guides, fantastic commentary videos, or lively discussions on our game, all of this has made us deeply appreciate how rare and fortunate it is for this game to be played and discussed by so many.  

At the same time, we are well aware that as players dive deeper into the game, some issues have surfaced. In response, we are committed to staying proactive and taking timely action. We aim to release daily updates to fix problems before the game reaches a stable state, ensuring your gaming experience remains smooth. For example, we’ve already resolved and patched the issue causing the game to crash when using certain mods. 

Additionally, we would like to tell you:  
1. [b]Regarding the 2025 Update Plan:[/b]
   We will strictly follow the update roadmap, which includes completing the remaining voiceovers, adding new storylines, helpers, and maps, to deliver an even richer gaming experience. We strive to make each major update exceed expectations.  
2. [b]Regarding the Uncle's Character and Storyline: [/b]
   We fully understand some players’ discomfort and concerns about this character. We will work on deeply revising the “Second Uncle” character design and related storyline to convey a more positive emotional experience.  
3. [b]Regarding the Fatiguing Money-Making Experience:[/b]
   Many players have shared that the current economic system feels overly stressful or lacks enjoyment. To address this, we plan to introduce new mechanics and buff adjustments, making money-making more strategic, rewarding, and less stressful.  

Finally, if you have any thoughts or suggestions, feel free to reach out to us anytime. We are always listening!  
We wish you an enjoyable gaming experience and a smooth life ahead!  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/ae765b8b63c5a4d0c93ecc0816b53bdd4e514192.png[/img]

notes.title: Release date set! Demo coming soon in the Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
Dear players,

Hello, everyone! We are excited to announce that the official release date for Matchmaking Inc. has been confirmed for January 16, 2025.

From the initial concept to the development process, we deeply understand your anticipation for this game. The production team has set expectations far beyond what the current version can deliver. We believe that Matchmaking Inc. is not just a fun simulation game, but also carries many emotional and cultural reflections on modern society.

We will take the remaining time to carefully refine the game, allowing players to fully experience the complexity and uniqueness of the topic of matchmaking in China. Whether you are a matchmaker in the game or a young adult navigating real-life relationships, we want the game to provide an authentic and engaging experience. To achieve this and present a more complete product, we need more time to polish it and release it when society’s attention is focused on the topic of matchmaking.

To thank you for your patience and show our appreciation for your continued support, we will be participating in the Steam Next Fest from October 15 to October 22 with the latest version of the game. This free demo includes several updates compared to the 2023 version, including:

[list]
[*] Full voice acting for the female protagonist, making the character more vivid; 
[*] Brand-new story comics for enhanced immersion and deeper character development;
[*] A new "Mysterious Dating" feature for a personalized social experience, encouraging you to play with friends!
[*] Unlockable surprise outfits, new cards, and dating scenarios as you reach specific affinity levels
[*] Five in-game days, with a tighter and more engaging pace. 
[/list]During the demo event, we will also open a feedback channel 👉 [url=https://docs.qq.com/form/page/DZnVCZFZKeWxxdlpG]Feedback Channel[/url]. Your feedback is crucial to us! Your input will help us further optimize the game and bring you an even better final version.

Thank you once again for your understanding and support. We believe that after this period of refinement, Matchmaking Inc. will meet you in 2025 in a more polished form, delivering a fun and emotional matchmaking journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/2d6d3d8b2ebd8ba2d76fc5f2d14c58ec53034ee1.png[/img]

notes.title: August 18th Update Announcement
notes.content:
Dear players
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43629968/2c1ebc495e932896362dcc88a9b2c701bceb68f6.png[/img]
Hello! In this update, we are bringing a series of brand-new content to enrich and enhance your gaming experience. Here are the detailed contents of this update:

Introducing the All-New Calendar Feature! We are excited to introduce the calendar feature to the game. This feature not only provides you with a clearer understanding of various in-game activities and important events, but also prepares for upcoming festivals and seasonal changes, making the game world even more realistic and vibrant.

Revamped Bathhouse Experience! We have comprehensively optimized and updated the bathhouse, adding a range of breathtaking scene effects and intriguing mechanics. Come and enjoy a more lifelike bathing experience!

Comprehensive Upgrade to Items and Equipment! Now, you can obtain or eliminate various interesting BUFF effects by acquiring and using items. We have also comprehensively adjusted and updated items and equipment to make your character even more powerful and diverse.

Main Quests Get Another Boost! This update continues to expand the main storyline, allowing you to delve into more captivating storylines and character development. We're excited to witness your impressive performances!

Enhanced Scene-Related Content! We have incorporated more captivating details and elements into each scene, enabling you to immerse yourself more deeply in the charm of the game world. Different scenes will offer you different experiences!

Continued Bug-Fixing Efforts! We are tirelessly working to resolve known BUG issues to ensure game stability and smoothness. If you encounter any problems, please feel free to provide us with feedback, and we will address them promptly.

We appreciate the support and enthusiastic participation of all players. Your feedback is our driving force for continuous improvement! We hope this update brings you an even more exciting gaming experience. If you have any opinions or suggestions, please don't hesitate to communicate with us. Let's all enjoy the fun brought by "Chinese Parents 2" together!

Wishing you a joyful gaming experience!

The "Chinese Parents 2" Operations Team
